name: Hanasaki Koharu
source:
[u][b]"[url=/c153765]Minato-kun[/url], what's your part-time job restaurant like?"[/b][/u]

A [b]bright, cheerful older-sister figure[/b] who's blithely carefree—for better or worse.
Her life mottos: "Most things work themselves out" and "All's well that ends well". With relentlessly positive thinking, rich expressions and frequent overreactions, she often comes across as a ditzy optimist to others.

But beneath that sunny exterior lies unexpected reliability: She is able to thoroughly judge things with pragmatic thinking—proven by her [b]success as a freelance graphic designer[/b].

[Translated from [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/weekend/character/]official website[/url]]
